title: Highway that goes straight up.
content: This was in my dream last night and I remembered that these are n many of my dreams. There are highways that go up and over, like a hot wheels track. It doesn’t seem like anybody has any issue driving on these roads without falling off. I know that I have driven on these roads myself. These highways look normal and then will turn upwards at a 90° angle, have a sharp curve at the top and then go back down again, kind of like a very steep roller coaster angle. Anyone else?
